newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IBM estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IBM estimate cut.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley analyst Steven Milunovich said he cut his first quarter earnings per share estimate on International Business Machines Corp to $2.30 from $2.38, citing the impact of the strong dollar.
-- The analyst said he cut his full-year 1997 estimate to $12.50 from $12.55.
-- He maintained his outperform rating on the stock.
-- Analysts at Salomon Brothers and Merrill Lynch also cut estimates on IBM, also citing the strong dollar.
-- The stock was off 1-1/4 at 144 in early trading.
